segments.name: Ecommerce Risk Intelligence
segments.description: AI-powered platform helping online merchants manage ecommerce fraud and risk through automated decisioning and fraud detection.
segments.evidence: Our AI-powered fraud management and risk intelligence platform is designed to help our merchants maximize revenue and profit to allow them to provide superior online shopping experiences for consumers.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay a percentage of approved transaction value for Chargeback Guarantee; fixed fees per transaction for other products.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge merchants using our Chargeback Guarantee product a percentage of every dollar of GMV that we approve on their behalf, so we are incentivized to approve as many orders as we safely can.
